items.title: 秋促仅需8.4的《火线迈阿密》，凭什么让人死到红温还舍不得关游戏？
items.summary: 如果预算只有10元，去推荐一款高难度又极度耐玩的游戏，你最想推荐谁？首先排除《和班尼福特一起掘地求生》，它确实很难，但绝大数人红温之后都会选择离开。其次《Limbo》、《Inside》、《Braid》这样的，解谜难度高不假，也能讲好一个故事，只是通关后便再少捡起来的机会。 如果只允许推荐一款，那我一定会推荐2012年的老古董《火线迈阿密》（Hotline Miami）。作为非常古老的俯视角射击游戏，它的胜利条件严苛到惊人的程度：你一次只有1条命，然后击败所有的敌人。 该系列的玩家已经超过500万，在不支持中文的情况下，仍有不少国区玩家“痛并快乐着”，称其为火线迈R密（因为重置关卡需要按R键）。

ja.title: 秋のプロモーションに必要なのは「FireWire Miami」の 8.4 だけです。なぜ人は死んでもゲームを閉じることをためらうのでしょうか?
ja.summary: 予算が 10 元しかなくて、難しくて非常にプレイしやすいゲームをお勧めするように求められたら、誰を一番お勧めしますか?まず、「Dig to Survive with Benny Ford」を除外します。それは確かに難しいことですが、大多数の人は赤熱を感じたら辞めることを選択するでしょう。次に、「Limbo」、「Inside」、「Braid」などのゲームはパズルを解くのが難しく、優れたストーリーを伝えることができますが、レベルを完了した後に手に入れる機会が少なくなります。 1 つだけお勧めできるとしたら、2012 年の名作『ホットライン マイアミ』を間違いなくお勧めします。非常に古いトップダウン シューティング ゲームであるため、その勝利条件は驚くほど厳しく、一度にライフを 1 つだけ持ち、その後すべての敵を倒します。このシリーズには 500 万人以上のプレイヤーがいます。中国語には対応していませんが、国内では「痛快」で FireWire Mai R の秘伝と呼んでいるプレイヤーが今でもたくさんいます (レベルをリセットするには R キーを押す必要があるため)。

en.title: The Autumn Promotion only requires 8.4 of "FireWire Miami", why is it that people are reluctant to close the game even after death?
en.summary: If you had a budget of only 10 yuan and were asked to recommend a difficult and extremely playable game, who would you most recommend? First of all, exclude "Dig to Survive with Benny Ford". It is indeed difficult, but the vast majority of people will choose to leave after red temperature. Secondly, games like "Limbo", "Inside", and "Braid" are difficult to solve puzzles and can tell a good story, but there are fewer opportunities to pick them up after completing the level. If I could only recommend one, I would definitely recommend the 2012 classic "Hotline Miami". As a very old top-down shooting game, its victory conditions are surprisingly strict: you only have one life at a time, and then defeat all enemies. There are more than 5 million players in this series. Even though it does not support Chinese, there are still many players in the country who are "painful and happy" and call it FireWire Mai R secret (because you need to press the R key to reset the level).

en.title: Why can "Onmyoji", which is in its tenth year, still allow players to crowd out the Canton Tower?
en.summary: At around 8 o'clock in the evening, on the second-floor platform of Canton Tower Square, the performance had not yet started, but players had been sitting densely under the stage for a long time. There were a lot of people at the scene, but it was not noisy. Most people were talking to friends at a moderate volume, or chatting nearby or on the Yin Yang Liao channel in the game. Generally speaking, they were very relaxed and comfortable. Behind me was a cosplayer who cosplayed as an Inugami. At first he was taking photos with other people, but then he seemed a little tired. He sat down cross-legged, took off his hood and held it in his arms. His face was very red and there was sweat on his forehead. The weather in Guangzhou these days is indeed very hot. In a sense, this "heat" also connects my usual feelings about "Onmyoji": intimacy, warmth, and longevity. Players waiting for the show to start gathered under the stage. Suddenly, there was some small commotion among the players on the side of the stage: a girl seemed to be standing up to hand out homemade materials, and the entire scene immediately became lively.

The real-time strategy type "StarCraft 2" was launched in 2003 and was not released until 2010. DLC updates will be stopped in 2020.
